discovered_findings.title: Security invariant reports 796 dual-permission wiring violations
evidence: docs/bugs/BUG-0049-report-only-ci-jobs-swallow-security-and-database-e2e-failur.md:54-55 records GitHub run 32009837400 job 95326876583: 894 guarded handlers in scope, 98 compliant and 796 violations.

docs/bugs/BUG-0049-report-only-ci-jobs-swallow-security-and-database-e2e-failur.md:66-69 records the full inventory: 1,198 handlers, 29 public, 275 outside PermissionsGuard, 894 in scope; violations split into 3 legacy-only missing, 715 matrix-only missing and 78 missing both.
.github/workflows/ci.yml:450-503 defines security-invariant-report as report-only evidence rather than a required failure signal.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: Use BUG-0049 for truthful result propagation and ITEM-0043 for staged promotion; burn down violations by module and re-run the invariant before promotion.

discovered_findings.title: Database E2E report remains red and worsened on the WP-02 task SHA
evidence: docs/bugs/BUG-0049-report-only-ci-jobs-swallow-security-and-database-e2e-failur.md:56-57 records GitHub job 95327538057: 6 suites failed, 9 passed, 136 tests failed and 91 passed.
docs/bugs/BUG-0049-report-only-ci-jobs-swallow-security-and-database-e2e-failur.md:70-72 ties the 6/15 suite and 136/227 test result to exact SHA 00511803ebb0e1343ff35535996df1af98c95834.
.github/workflows/ci.yml:324-418 provides the ephemeral-PostgreSQL database-e2e-report infrastructure but does not propagate a failing test verdict to the required gate.

Exact WP-02 runs 32020076245 at 47b127f and 32021401010 at final task SHA 03f30cb both had the same 7 failed / 8 passed suites; test totals varied from 148/79 to 147/80. Post-merge run 32022417483 at c554f45 shifted to 5 failed / 10 passed suites and 128 failed / 99 passed tests; attendance-review and attendance-operational passed after failing twice, so QA-ATT-007 is PASS_WITH_RISKS pending repeatability proof.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: Classify the five stable suite failures and two run-variable suites by application defect, fixture drift and infrastructure, retain the raw exit status, and do not infer PASS from the green report-only job.

discovered_findings.title: BUG-0019 is VERIFIED while its browser regression remains test.fixme
evidence: e2e/tests/flow-b-partner-journey.spec.ts:171-177 says the unreachable partner-inquiry review is the BUG-0019 regression coverage.
e2e/tests/flow-b-partner-journey.spec.ts:219-228 says there is no inbound link and marks the BUG-0019 assertion test.fixme.
docs/qa/runs/2026-08-15-browser-e2e-and-provisioning-recovery-572a3b8.md:88 records that the BUG-0019 assertion is present but fixme.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: Re-open or reclassify BUG-0019 unless a reachable navigation path can be demonstrated and the fixme assertion enabled and passed.

discovered_findings.title: REG-022 has no canonical bug-record field
evidence: docs/qa/regressions/index.md:284-296 defines REG-022 and its regression test but omits the Bug record row used by surrounding regression entries.
docs/backlog/items/ITEM-0030-partner-inquiry-form-does-not-yet-capture-partnership-model.md:23-44 is the durable canonical record for the same partnership-model gap.
docs/qa/scenarios/QA-PARTNER-003-partner-enquiry-acquisition-records-a-distinguishable-partne.md:12 links the reusable scenario to REG-022.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: Link REG-022 explicitly to ITEM-0030 or adopt a regression metadata field that accepts canonical BUG and ITEM records without inventing a duplicate bug.

discovered_findings.title: Seven active regressions lack a reusable QA scenario link
evidence: docs/qa/regressions/index.md:91,224,236,248,260,450,464 defines the seven active regression entries.
Command: rg -n 'REG-006|REG-017|REG-018|REG-019|REG-020|REG-034|REG-035' docs/qa/scenarios returned no reusable scenario file references.
PLAN-002 and PLAN-012 mention REG-006 and REG-018, but plan-level mention is not a scenario execution contract.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: Create or link one durable scenario per active regression, preserving the existing regression entry and canonical record relationship.

discovered_findings.title: QA-PAY-001 LAST_RUN contains two dates
evidence: docs/qa/scenarios/QA-PAY-001-payroll-operations-privileges-are-separated-from-employee-re.md:13 contains LAST_RUN: 2026-08-17 2026-08-16.
The same header declares LAST_RESULT: PASS at line 14, but the malformed date prevents a reliable single-run timestamp.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: Set LAST_RUN to the one evidenced execution date and extend QA validation to require one ISO date.

discovered_findings.title: Partner and onboarding browser scenario results do not reflect the latest CI execution

discovered_findings.title: Nine BLOCKED_INFRASTRUCTURE scenarios need reclassification against infrastructure that now exists

discovered_findings.title: Documented test counts trail the current source and latest executed API suite

current_counts.latest_database_e2e: 15 suites; task runs 32020076245/32021401010 had the same 7 failed / 8 passed and 147–148 failed / 79–80 passed tests; post-merge run 32022417483 had 5 failed / 10 passed suites and 128 failed / 99 passed tests

evidence: Read-only file count command: rg --files services/api/src -g '*.spec.ts' => 169; services/api/test -g '*.e2e-spec.ts' => 15; apps/web => 17; apps/admin => 10; apps/landing => 3; e2e/tests => 2.
docs/qa/runs/2026-08-17-framework-remediation-e6a173d.md:39,58 records the latest full API run as 169 suites, 1,251 passed and 1 skipped.

At discovery, docs/development/ci.md, .agent/context/testing-architecture.md and docs/development/branch-protection.md carried mutually stale counts ranging from 9 to 13 API E2E suites and 127 to 169 API unit specs.
WP-02 reconciled the maintained testing and CI documents plus the stale workflow comments to the dated source/run baseline above; historical run records were preserved as historical evidence.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: Replace fragile point-in-time counts with generated counts or a dated verified baseline and keep executed-test totals distinct from source-file counts.

discovered_findings.title: Production dependency graph contains 17 advisories

discovered_findings.title: Tenant web routing unconditionally prefers x-forwarded-host
evidence: apps/web/proxy.ts:163-165 prefers x-forwarded-host over Host for every request.
services/api/src/modules/tenant-domains/request-hostname.ts:14-31 accepts forwarded host only through the repository's trusted-proxy decision.
docs/backlog/items/ITEM-0044-validate-forwarded-host-before-tenant-web-workspace-resoluti.md:27-41 captures the discrepancy and source locations.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: Resolve under ITEM-0044 by applying one explicit trusted-proxy boundary and testing spoofed forwarded-host input.

discovered_findings.title: Tenant web environment examples disagree on root-domain configuration
evidence: apps/web/.env.example:13 and apps/web/.env.local.example:9 declare different root/base-domain examples.
docs/qa/runs/2026-08-17-web-app-documentation-1af3690.md:75 records the discrepancy.
packages/config/platform-domains.js and docs/environment-variables.md are the canonical comparison points named by ITEM-0045.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: Resolve under ITEM-0045, then add a configuration contract test covering both committed examples.

discovered_findings.title: Landing app has no loading, error or not-found boundary
evidence: Command: rg --files apps/landing/app | rg '(loading|error|not-found)\.(tsx|ts|jsx|js)$' returned no files.
docs/backlog/items/ITEM-0046-add-landing-loading-error-and-not-found-boundaries.md:27-29 records the missing boundaries and framework-default failure behavior.
docs/qa/runs/2026-08-16-monorepo-app-documentation-78072d2.md:57 is the originating QA evidence.

discovered_findings.title: Repository cleanup candidates are preserved for Integrator verification
evidence: npm run repo:health at 0051180 reports STALE_WORKTREES 1 and STALE_BRANCHES 1: dijipeople-bugs / agent/final-parent-implementation has no commits beyond main, and agent/bug-closure-stabilization is merged with no unique commits.

The same health report preserves agent/authz-batch0 and related authz branches, agent/global-remediation-program, and preserve/obsidian-sync-example-deletion because Git still reports unique commits; code-history inspection separately found the authz changes patch-equivalent to commits already on develop.

The 80-path dirty snapshot included gateway build outputs created by a bounded local validation attempt and a partial dependency directory. Those tracked build outputs were restored and the partial directory was moved outside the worktree; current git status contains only expected WP-01 record/generated paths.
discovered_findings.owner_decision_required: NO — this is technical repository hygiene. The Integrator must verify patch equivalence, worktree cleanliness and branch ownership before any cleanup.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: Do not delete from discovery. Perform scoped cleanup under Integrator control after the active program package is integrated; preserve the human-created feature branches.

discovered_findings.title: Manual Obsidian Engineering Rules incorrectly says no CI exists
evidence: At discovery, docs/obsidian-bootstrap/11 - Agent Knowledge/Engineering Rules.md:81-85 said there was no CI, no .github workflows and nothing running on push.
.github/workflows/ci.yml exists and docs/development/ci.md:42-51 enumerates required and report-only CI jobs.
WP-02 corrected the repository bootstrap Engineering Rules and Releases note; the user-owned external vault remains pending a post-integration knowledge sync and read-back verification.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: After integration, sync and read back the external vault without overwriting unrelated user-owned content; close this finding only when the actual vault distinguishes required gates from fail-open/report-only jobs.

discovered_findings.title: Generated Obsidian vault content is out of sync
evidence: The initial discovery snapshot reported 31 generated-note differences; this is the stable finding requested for TASK-0005.

Fresh read-only command npm run knowledge:verify on 2026-08-17 checked 20 folders, 300 notes and 1,425 wikilinks with 0 unresolved links, then failed with 39 problems after the new TASK-0005 BUG/ITEM/session/run records were added.

The 39 current problems include missing vault notes for BUG-0049 through BUG-0052, ITEM-0044 through ITEM-0046, TASK-0005 and SESSION-0003 plus changed dashboards, indexes and generated QA/history notes.
discovered_findings.recommended_remediation: After repository records and generated indexes stabilize, run knowledge sync once under the appropriate lease and re-run knowledge verification; preserve manual notes.
